newsitem.title: USA: First of Michigan gets new top officers.
newsitem.headline: First of Michigan gets new top officers.

text.p: First of Michigan Capital Corp said Friday it has named Robert Michelotti as president and Mark Shobe as chief operating officer of its First of Michigan subsidiary. The appointments are effective today.
First of Michigan's former president, Conrad Koski, resigned yesterday to pursue other interests.

First of Michigan is the principal subsidiary of First of Michigan Capital Corp. It is the state's largest full-service securities firm with 33 offices in Michigan. It provides investment services to both retail and institutional clients.
Michelotti had been a director of branches and sales and a member of the executive committee of Roney & Co.

Shobe was senior vp-direct banking for Comerica Inc. As chief operating officer for First of Michigan, he is responsible for finance, operations, technology, human resources, compliance, legal and other administrative areas.
